_meta.source: Figma file uI6oKmJ0qDhsEuE0nFah2W, catalog page "Form / Blocks" (node 1307:2208).
_meta.purpose: Atomic form fragments captured 1:1 from the catalog block frames. patterns.json composes them via $ref.
_meta.spacingModel: Fields inside a fieldset sit at gap md (the captured 16px rhythm). A heading pair (title + description) is one block at lg. Fieldsets inside the form column are separated at xl.
_meta.fieldModel: Every field is label-above and fills the form width. Two fields share a row only when they belong together (first/last name, postcode/city) — that is a ContainerHorizontal of two fill-width Inputs, never a Grid.
_meta.placeholders: <Angle brackets> mark content the agent MUST replace. <Trailing?> marks an optional node: drop it when no content applies, never render it empty.

form.section-title.purpose: Form or fieldset heading pair: h2 headline with an optional large description.

form.text-field.purpose: Single-line text field, label above, filling the form width.

form.field-row.purpose: Two related fields side by side, each filling half the row.

form.upload-field.source: 🧪 Upload (Core Lab, Concept) — the REAL upload component.
form.upload-field.purpose: File upload built on the official Upload component: a drop area with its own label and Filled button. Its End Slot carries the previews and the limit counter, so the whole control is ONE component instead of an Image grid plus a loose Button — and never a dashed rectangle. Upload is Concept, so it needs the concept_components opt-in. Previews are EMPTY Images at a registered ratio (the designer drops the assets in); the counter states the limits the process defines.

form.textarea-field.purpose: Multi-line text field for free-form input.

form.checkbox-field.purpose: Single checkbox — a consent or a standalone yes/no choice.

form.checkbox-group.purpose: Labelled group of checkboxes for a multi-select choice.

form.radio-group.purpose: Labelled group of radio buttons for a single choice among few options.

form.select-field.purpose: Dropdown for a single choice among many options.

form.actions.purpose: Closing action row: the alternative action as ghost, the submit as Brand.

form.required-note.purpose: Form-level convention note, e.g. that required fields are marked.
